newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: No plans to sell shares - S.Lanka Insurance Corp.
newsitem.headline: No plans to sell shares - S.Lanka Insurance Corp.

text.p: State-owned Sri Lanka Insurance Corp (SLIC) said on Tuesday it knew of no plans to sell off any of its shares to private investors.
SLIC is one of two government-run insurance firms and one of only five companies licenced to operate in Sri Lanka.
The government has said it will liberalise its domestic insurance industry and plans to divest minority and majority stakes in many state firms in the financial services industry.
But Chairman Jagath Wickremasinghe told Reuters he was not aware of any plans that would effect his firm.
"We are now 100 percent owned. I'm not aware of any plans to sell off shares," he said in an interview.
